image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a transparent plastic audio cassette tape. The cassette features two black spools with visible magnetic tape wound around them. A white paper label is affixed to the top face, containing handwritten-style text that appears distorted and illegible (gibberish). The casing shows molded details including screw holes and structural ribs. The background is a plain, light-colored surface.

artifact_observations.location: White label on top face of cassette
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the label is structurally coherent as letters but semantically nonsensical and distorted. Characters merge and lack standard kerning/spacing, a classic AI generation artifact.
The texture of the 'tape' on the spools lacks the fine, parallel striations of real magnetic tape. It appears somewhat smudged or painterly rather than mechanically precise.
The central hub of the right spool appears slightly irregular and fused with the surrounding tape texture, lacking the crisp mechanical definition of a real plastic gear/hub.

To assess the overall realism, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle global distortions missed by specific audits.
